explanation: A whole-grain cereal ingredient as named on the label. When it is the first ingredient the ingredient score gets a bonus (methodology, ingredient_deductions).
reference_source: Team definition (methodology v0.1.0); term list in ingredient_terms.csv

explanation: A refined cereal flour such as maida. When it is the first ingredient the ingredient score loses points (methodology).
A sugar-type ingredient added to the product. It counts toward total sugars and is the class checked for a 'no added sugar' claim (FSSAI reg. 6(1)).
reference_source: FSS (Advertising and Claims) Regulations 2018 reg. 6(1)(a)(i) lists sugar types

explanation: Palm oil or palmolein, named on the label.

An oil declared without naming its source, such as 'edible vegetable oil'. The transparency score loses points because the source is not disclosed.
A hydrogenated or partially hydrogenated fat, or vanaspati, as named on the label.
Common salt or iodised salt as an ingredient. Its amount is assessed through the sodium value, not here.
A cocoa ingredient such as cocoa solids or cocoa powder.
A flavouring named without saying whether it is natural, nature-identical or artificial.
reference_source: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations 2020 flavour declaration categories
